rows.text: Ministry of Home Affairs Corrigendum S.O. 2487(E), New Delhi, 4 August 2017 (F. No. 2/4/2017-Public, Shri Prakash, Joint Secretary): in partial modification of Resolution No. 2318(E) dated 25 July 2017, the name of the President of India for all official purposes is 'Shri Ram Nath Kovind'.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only. The Election Commission's notices, the Returning Officer's declaration of the result and its Gazette publication, the programme for the ceremony of assumption of office, the oath administered by the Chief Justice, the Ministry of Home Affairs resolution and proclamation of the assumption of office, the holder's address on assumption, prospective term-expiry notices, farewells, stylings of a predecessor as former President and retrospective statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Prime Minister, the Vice-President (including any service as acting President), ministers and party offices are excluded.
